intro: Oman is an absolute monarchy ruled by a sultan.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The sultan is head of state and government. A two-chamber council, with an elected Majlis al-Shura and an appointed State Council, advises on laws.

chapters.title: Quiet diplomacy
text: Oman keeps friendly ties with almost everyone and often hosts secret talks, such as those between the US and Iran.
